concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-uplift-uplift-requirements]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Uplift Web integration, webhook, five-module and conditional request-data requirements/recommendations; shopper-field API validity differs from Uplift guidance and no activation or results are proved.
warnings: Raw lines 93–97 say shopperIP/shopperReference/shopperEmail are not required for the payment request to work, while the table later uses must-be-included language for Uplift/flow goals (lines 113–116); do not convert it to unconditional API schema requiredness.
Version floors and EEA/UK authentication wording are dated source claims; no current support or legal-compliance determination follows.
Protect premium, network-token optimization, Real Time Account Updater, Auto Rescue and more methods are recommendations, not universal prerequisites or activated products.
